premises.text: Construction has been plagued with inefficiencies and productivity has stagnated
premises.evidence_span: Construction as an industry has been plagued with inefficiencies for decades. Productivity has stagnated.

premises.text: A significant amount of materials on job sites are wasted due to errors
premises.evidence_span: the vast majority of tasks are still managed on paper. A variety of these disjointed processes combined with oftentimes simple human errors result in almost 20% of materials on a given job site being completely wasted

premises.text: Over $100 billion is wasted in construction each year due to errors
premises.evidence_span: contribute to over $100 billion wasted in construction each year

premises.text: A connected ecosystem of hardware and software can reduce errors and streamline operations
premises.evidence_span: Recon Tools has set out to create a connected ecosystem of hardware and software products to significantly reduce these errors and streamline operations on the job site.

premises.text: Digital measuring tools can replace traditional tools to improve efficiency
premises.evidence_span: the way we look at it is really focus on tools that are used for data capture and execution on the job site.

premises.text: The ROC app can streamline measurement operations and reduce human error
premises.evidence_span: the core of the Recon platform is the Rock job site app. The Rock job site app is a simple and easy-to-use platform that works on any mobile device

value.text: Construction processes can be made more efficient and less error-prone through digital tools
value.evidence_span: it's time we demand more from our contractors and stop expecting errors, cost overruns, and timeline delays as inevitable.

notes: No separate premises for the app and hardware as they are part of the same ecosystem.
